title: Daily Streak
needs_owner_check: ChromaticDaily (/daily) is on mc-server origin/main; confirm it is live on the SMP.
summary: **Daily Streak** is a reward for every day you log in. Claim it with `/daily`. The rewards get better for 7 days in a row, then stay at the top.

ul: {{icon:tripwire_hook}} Day 3: 1 Reward Key and 10 minutes of [vote fly](/wiki/smp/vote-fly/) time
{{icon:tripwire_hook}} Day 7: 1 Chroma Key, then again every day your streak lasts
You can claim once per calendar day. A new day starts at midnight, New York time.
Claim the day after your last claim to move one day up. Miss a day and the streak starts over at day 1.
When you join with today's reward unclaimed, the daily screen opens a few seconds later. Press **Later** to close it; `/daily` opens it again.
Keys open the crates at spawn. Right-click a crate with its key.
Log in for a moment each day to keep the streak, even when you cannot play.

history.text: Added daily login rewards on a 7-day streak, with `/daily`.
